headline: RapWire 24/7: Five distinct stories — Sept. 23, 2026 — 5 PM Pacific
body: This verified five-slide RapWire news carousel covers five distinct current stories: J. Cole’s Indie 5000 launch; Outkast’s trademark suit against Ovrkast; Rockstar’s GTA 6 Vice City arena marketing; Ye unveiling Donda West Way in Chicago; and 2hollis announcing Pirouette. Each story is separately sourced, visually identified, and labeled with context and attribution.

caption:
#RapWire24/7 — five distinct stories for Sept. 23, 2026.
1) J. Cole’s independently developed Indie 5000 sneaker launched first in Fayetteville on Sept. 23, following a five-year build and a hometown-first release plan.
Sources: https://thesource.com/2026/09/22/j-cole-bets-on-himself-with-hometown-launch-of-indie-5000-sneaker/ | https://sneakernews.com/2026/09/22/j-cole-shoes-dreamer-indie-5000/
Handles: @JColeNC
2) Outkast’s trademark company sued rapper-producer Ovrkast in Atlanta federal court, alleging trademark infringement and breach of an agreement to change the name. The claims remain allegations.
Sources: https://au.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/outkast-sues-ovrkast-trademark-infringement-big-boi-andre-101393/ | https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/outkasts-trademark-company-sues-rapper-ovrkast-claiming-he-reneged-on-deal-to-drop-nearly-identical-name/
Handles: @Outkast · @ovrkast
3) Rockstar’s Grand Theft Auto VI rollout reached Miami’s Kaseya Center with a giant Vice City sign installed on the arena. Local reporting says the county-approved promotion is part of the game’s launch marketing.
Sources: https://www.local10.com/news/local/2026/09/18/miami-dade-commissioners-raise-concerns-about-countys-welcome-to-vice-city-deal-with-grand-theft-auto-vi-game/ | https://www.destructoid.com/gta6-marketing-ramps-up-vice-city-sign-miami-heat-arena/
Handles: @RockstarGames · @GTAVI
4) Ye attended the Chicago ceremony unveiling Dr. Donda West Way, an honorary name for part of East 78th Street in South Shore. The tribute recognizes his late mother’s work in education and community life.
Sources: https://www.wbez.org/arts-culture/2026/09/22/donda-west-way-south-shore-street-renaming | https://abc7chicago.com/post/chicago-name-street-professor-donda-west-mother-of-kanye-west-at-78th-and-south-shore-drive/19857809/
Handles: @kanyewest
5) 2hollis announced the forthcoming album Pirouette for Nov. 11 via Interscope, alongside the new single “Sex.” The announcement follows a run of fashion and music coverage around the rising artist.
Sources: https://www.universalmusic.ca/2026/09/22/2hollis-announces-new-album-pirouette-releasing-november-11th/ | https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/articles/music/popular/today
Handles: @2hollis

@Rapwire247
